summary: MDA Space Ltd. (TSX/NYSE: MDA) filed a material change report on Form 6-K disclosing its definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Blue Canyon Technologies LLC from RTX's Raytheon for US$620 million (C$874 million) in an all-cash transaction, subject to purchase price adjustments. The deal expands MDA's US defence market access and adds BCT's spacecraft manufacturing and mission services with over 400 employees in Denver. The transaction is expected to close in 2026 and be accretive to Adjusted EBITDA and EPS in 2027. The board recommends the deal; no advisors named. Watch for regulatory clearance under Hart-Scott-Rodino and closing conditions.
